specific_objectives: 9.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe various Aircraft engineering systems.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of control system diagrams; Safety: Do not operate live hydraulic systems; Supervision: Instructor monitors diagram interpretation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the aircraft control system?
Name three major categories of aircraft engineering systems.
How does the control system differ from the power plant system?

development.content:
Hydraulic power supply units
Control valves and actuators
Pilot control surfaces linkage
Feedback mechanisms in controls
System pressure monitoring devices

Electrical control actuation systems
Mechanical cable and pushrod systems
Hydro-mechanical servo systems
Redundancy in control circuits
Failure modes of control components

topics: Standard torque values for control bolts
development.content:
Integration of flight control computers
Maintenance access points for controls
Standard torque values for control bolts
Inspection intervals for control linkages
Troubleshooting common control faults

summary_questions: Explain the role of hydraulic actuators in moving control surfaces.
Describe one method used to ensure redundancy in the control system.
Identify two common failure modes in mechanical cable systems.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the need for simple oxygen systems and the effects of lack of O2, including types of O2 regulators, maintenance, servicing, and safety, as covered in LP 10.

pft_rows.syllabus: Need for simple oxygen system and pressurized cabin effect of lack of O2, Types of O2 regulators Maintenance of O2 system, servicing and safety precautions.
